title: Change device hostname
summary: Set a new hostname for the current device using NetworkManager. This requires administrator privileges.

steps.explain: Change the hostname of the current device to a new value.

placeholders.name: NEW_HOSTNAME
placeholders.description: The new hostname to set for the device.

rollback.explain: Set the hostname back to its previous value.

placeholders.name: OLD_HOSTNAME
placeholders.description: The previous hostname of the device.

warnings: Changing the hostname may affect network services or scripts that rely on the current name.
